sampling_rule: Random(20260807); RTS: shuffle family list + items within family, round-robin pick 14; then SimBench same procedure pick 11

items.question: For 2020-07-07, summarize total day-ahead generation by fuel.
items.sql: SELECT g.fuel, ROUND(SUM(d.generation_mw), 2) AS total_generation_mwh FROM dispatch_da d JOIN generators g ON d.generator_uid = g.generator_uid WHERE d.timestamp >= '2020-07-07 00:00:00' AND d.timestamp < datetime('2020-07-07 00:00:00', '+1 day') GROUP BY g.fuel ORDER BY total_generation_mwh DESC, g.fuel;

items.question: Return the five renewable generators with the highest available MW at 2020-01-01 04:00:00, including their fuel labels.
items.sql: SELECT r.generator_uid, g.fuel, r.available_mw FROM renewable_availability_da r JOIN generators g ON r.generator_uid = g.generator_uid WHERE r.timestamp = '2020-01-01 04:00:00' ORDER BY r.available_mw DESC, r.generator_uid LIMIT 5;

items.question: How many Solar-fueled generators are there and what is their total maximum capacity?
items.sql: SELECT g.fuel, COUNT(*) AS generator_count, ROUND(SUM(c.pmax_mw), 2) AS total_pmax_mw FROM generators g JOIN generator_constraints c ON g.generator_uid = c.generator_uid WHERE g.fuel = 'Solar' GROUP BY g.fuel;

items.question: Return the top 10 generators by maximum MW capacity.
items.sql: SELECT g.generator_uid, g.fuel, c.pmax_mw FROM generators g JOIN generator_constraints c ON g.generator_uid = c.generator_uid ORDER BY c.pmax_mw DESC, g.generator_uid LIMIT 10;

items.question: List generators connected to buses in area 1, with their bus names and fuels.
items.sql: SELECT g.generator_uid, b.bus_name, g.fuel FROM generators g JOIN buses b ON g.bus_id = b.bus_id WHERE b.area = 1 ORDER BY b.bus_name, g.generator_uid;

items.question: Which generators require at least 4 hours of minimum up time?
items.sql: SELECT g.generator_uid, g.unit_type, c.min_up_time_hr FROM generators g JOIN generator_constraints c ON g.generator_uid = c.generator_uid WHERE c.min_up_time_hr >= 4 ORDER BY c.min_up_time_hr DESC, g.generator_uid;

items.question: Return the top 1 generators by non-fuel start cost, excluding missing values.
items.sql: SELECT g.generator_uid, g.fuel, c.nonfuel_start_cost_usd FROM generator_costs c JOIN generators g ON c.generator_uid = g.generator_uid WHERE c.nonfuel_start_cost_usd IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.nonfuel_start_cost_usd DESC, g.generator_uid LIMIT 1;

items.question: What was the average day-ahead load for each region on 2020-01-02?
items.sql: SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(load_mw), 2) AS average_load_mw FROM load_timeseries_da WHERE timestamp >= '2020-01-02 00:00:00' AND timestamp < datetime('2020-01-02 00:00:00', '+1 day') GROUP BY region ORDER BY region;

items.question: What was the maximum day-ahead spinning reserve requirement for each product on 2020-01-01?
items.sql: SELECT reserve_product, ROUND(MAX(requirement_mw), 3) AS maximum_requirement_mw FROM reserve_requirements_da WHERE timestamp >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND timestamp < datetime('2020-01-01 00:00:00', '+1 day') GROUP BY reserve_product ORDER BY reserve_product;

items.question: Which generators produced positive output at 2020-07-05 04:00:00 in the all-transmission day-ahead solution?
items.sql: SELECT generator_uid, generation_mw FROM dispatch_da WHERE timestamp = '2020-07-05 04:00:00' AND transmission_scenario = 'allTX' AND generation_mw > 0 ORDER BY generation_mw DESC, generator_uid;

items.question: List the generator identifiers and unit types for Hydro-fueled units.
items.sql: SELECT generator_uid, unit_type FROM generators WHERE fuel = 'Hydro' ORDER BY generator_uid;

items.question: For 2020-07-05, summarize total day-ahead generation by fuel.
items.sql: SELECT g.fuel, ROUND(SUM(d.generation_mw), 2) AS total_generation_mwh FROM dispatch_da d JOIN generators g ON d.generator_uid = g.generator_uid WHERE d.timestamp >= '2020-07-05 00:00:00' AND d.timestamp < datetime('2020-07-05 00:00:00', '+1 day') GROUP BY g.fuel ORDER BY total_generation_mwh DESC, g.fuel;

items.question: Return the five renewable generators with the highest available MW at 2020-01-01 01:00:00, including their fuel labels.
items.sql: SELECT r.generator_uid, g.fuel, r.available_mw FROM renewable_availability_da r JOIN generators g ON r.generator_uid = g.generator_uid WHERE r.timestamp = '2020-01-01 01:00:00' ORDER BY r.available_mw DESC, r.generator_uid LIMIT 5;

items.question: How many Oil-fueled generators are there and what is their total maximum capacity?
items.sql: SELECT g.fuel, COUNT(*) AS generator_count, ROUND(SUM(c.pmax_mw), 2) AS total_pmax_mw FROM generators g JOIN generator_constraints c ON g.generator_uid = c.generator_uid WHERE g.fuel = 'Oil' GROUP BY g.fuel;

items.question: Show transformer names with their high- and low-voltage bus names.
items.sql: SELECT t.name AS transformer_name, hb.name AS high_voltage_bus, lb.name AS low_voltage_bus FROM transformers t JOIN buses hb ON hb.bus_id = t.hv_bus_id JOIN buses lb ON lb.bus_id = t.lv_bus_id ORDER BY t.transformer_id

items.question: How many buses belong to each nominal voltage level?
items.sql: SELECT nominal_kv, COUNT(*) AS bus_count FROM buses GROUP BY nominal_kv ORDER BY nominal_kv DESC

items.question: How many buses are represented in this SimBench network?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bus_count FROM buses

items.question: Which transformer has the largest rated power?
items.sql: SELECT transformer_id, name, rated_power_mva FROM transformers ORDER BY rated_power_mva DESC, transformer_id LIMIT 1

items.question: Which buses have no incident line?
items.sql: SELECT b.bus_id, b.name FROM buses b LEFT JOIN lines l1 ON l1.from_bus_id = b.bus_id LEFT JOIN lines l2 ON l2.to_bus_id = b.bus_id WHERE l1.line_id IS NULL AND l2.line_id IS NULL ORDER BY b.bus_id

items.question: Which generators are controllable?
items.sql: SELECT generator_id, name, generator_type FROM generators WHERE controllable = 1 ORDER BY generator_id

items.question: Count loads by the nominal voltage of their connected bus.
items.sql: SELECT b.nominal_kv, COUNT(*) AS load_count FROM loads l JOIN buses b ON b.bus_id = l.bus_id GROUP BY b.nominal_kv ORDER BY b.nominal_kv DESC

items.question: What is the average line length in kilometres?
items.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(length_km), 6) AS average_line_length_km FROM lines

items.question: How many switches are represented?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS switch_count FROM switches

items.question: Which five lines are the longest?
items.sql: SELECT line_id, name, length_km FROM lines ORDER BY length_km DESC, line_id LIMIT 5

items.question: Which lines connect buses with different nominal voltages?
items.sql: SELECT l.line_id, l.name, fb.nominal_kv AS from_kv, tb.nominal_kv AS to_kv FROM lines l JOIN buses fb ON fb.bus_id = l.from_bus_id JOIN buses tb ON tb.bus_id = l.to_bus_id WHERE fb.nominal_kv <> tb.nominal_kv ORDER BY l.line_id
